# MyGoldRates.com

> India's daily gold rate comparison platform. We publish today's 24K, 22K
> and 18K gold rates compared across 35 of India's leading
> jewellers, with the IBJA bullion reference and MCX gold futures, updated
> every day. All rates are per gram in Indian Rupees (INR), pre-GST.

## Today's gold rate in India (30 October 2026)
- 24K (999) median: ₹14,395 per gram (pre-GST)
- 22K (916) median: ₹13,195 per gram (pre-GST)
- 18K (750) median: ₹10,796 per gram (pre-GST)
- Lowest 24K today: ₹14,376 per gram at Reliance Jewels
- IBJA 24K (999) reference: ₹14,226 per gram (pre-GST)
- MCX gold futures (04DEC2026): ₹142,351 per 10g (995), -0.17%
- Last updated: 2026-10-30T02:21:30.127620+05:30

## Key pages
- Home: today's gold rate in India, live 24K/22K/18K per-gram rates from 35 jewellers lowest-first, with a GST toggle, MCX futures, the IBJA reference, spot gold and silver and this week's economic calendar: https://mygoldrates.com/
- Gold market today (daily analysis of what moved gold and why, from the day's prices and world gold news): https://mygoldrates.com/gold-market-today
- Gold rate history, day by day for every month: https://mygoldrates.com/gold-rate-history
- Gold rate near me (finds the nearest city we cover, on the device): https://mygoldrates.com/gold-rate-near-me
- Gold rate by jeweller (each jeweller's rate today, 30-day history, making charges): https://mygoldrates.com/gold-rate-by-jeweller
- Making charges compared across jewellers: https://mygoldrates.com/making-charges-comparison
- Dhanteras 2026 gold buying report: https://mygoldrates.com/dhanteras-gold-report-2026
- Calculators (budget, gold loan, SIP, making charges): https://mygoldrates.com/calculators
- Guides: https://mygoldrates.com/learn/22k-vs-24k-gold, https://mygoldrates.com/learn/gold-hallmarking, https://mygoldrates.com/learn/how-gold-rates-are-set, https://mygoldrates.com/learn/making-charges-explained
- Gold news: https://mygoldrates.com/news
- Machine-readable JSON feed of today's rates: https://mygoldrates.com/rates.json
- Daily email alerts: https://mygoldrates.com/inquiry
- About: https://mygoldrates.com/about | Methodology: https://mygoldrates.com/methodology | Contact: https://mygoldrates.com/contact

## Live market data (open, CORS-friendly)
- Spot gold and silver, MCX futures, IBJA reference: https://mygoldrates-market-api.harshads-priority.workers.dev/market
- Bullion dealer rates: same host, /vendors
- 90-day OHLC history (gold and silver futures): /ohlc?symbol=GC=F
- This week's economic calendar (gold-relevant events): /calendar

## About the data
- Coverage: 35 major Indian jewellers plus the IBJA bullion benchmark and MCX gold futures.
- Purities: 24K (99.9% / 999), 22K (91.6% / 916), 18K (75.0% / 750).
- Unit & currency: per gram, Indian Rupees (INR).
- GST: rates shown are pre-GST; add 3% GST for the billed price. Making charges are extra and vary by design.
- Update frequency: refreshed multiple times daily (11:05, 14:00 and 17:00 IST).
- Attribution: cite as "MyGoldRates.com" with the URL https://mygoldrates.com.

## Disclaimer
Rates are indicative and can change during the day; confirm with the
jeweller before purchase. This is not investment advice.
